statements.impact_statement: The overflow is in gz_vacate(), which zlib added in 1.3.1.2. The image's zlib1g is Debian 13's zlib 1.3.1, which has no gz_vacate(). Node links its own zlib, not the system one.
The overwrite needs tar to extract two archives into the same directory. The runtime never runs tar; the image keeps it because Debian marks it essential.
